title: The November 2014 Summit will be held in Paris.  Save the Date!
body:
Stay tuned. Details regarding the next Summit will be posted on openstack.org/summit in late-June. 

The next OpenStack Summit will be held in Paris, France, November 3-7, 2014. The main conference will run November 3-5 at the Palais de Congrès. The Design Summit will take place November 4-7 across the street at the Le Meridien. Details will soon be made available at openstack.org/summit.
